title: Corporate Wellness Partnership: smallest of the wellness-reimbursement limits
content:
Under the Corporate Wellness Partnership, the amount actually waived under a wellness-reimbursement waiver is the smallest of three figures: the candidate amount, the remaining annual-cap headroom, and the payment-based ceiling. Whichever of those three figures is smallest becomes the amount waived, and that amount is rounded to 2 decimal places.

Worked example (hypothetical): if the candidate amount were $18.00, the remaining annual-cap headroom were $20.00, and the payment-based ceiling were $12.00, the smallest of the three — $12.00 — is the amount actually waived. If instead the payment-based ceiling were $50.00 while the candidate amount stayed at $18.00 and the headroom at $20.00, the smallest of the three — $18.00, the candidate amount itself — is the amount actually waived.
